name: Mien
summary: Miến is chewy glass noodle made from mung bean or sweet potato, mild and savory, topped with chicken, crab, or freshwater eel, in broth or stir-fried.
origin: Hanoi. Vietnam Tourism includes the bowl on the city’s ten-dish list.
texture: Vietnam Tourism’s ten-dish list calls the noodle chewy.
taste: The same list calls the bowl mild and savory.
howToEat: Quẩy, the fried breadstick, goes in the broth. Dip the breadstick in the soup.
The bowl is topped with chicken, crab, or freshwater eel, in broth or stir-fried.
where: Vietnam Tourism’s ten-dish list points to a mixed bowl at 6 Phùng Hưng, Hoàn Kiếm. The hour is Check on arrival.
